newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Dec tax revenue up 7.8 pct on year ago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Dec tax revenue up 7.8 pct on year ago.

text.p: Argentina's tax revenue in December reached $3.83 billion, a 7.8 percent increase over December 1995, the Economy Ministry said Thursday.
Tax collection was 3.2 percent higher than a month earlier, when the government collected $3.71 billion.
Total value added tax collected reached $1.51 billion, up 1.7 percent from last December and down 8.1 percent from November this year.
Income tax collection reached $554 million, up 10 percent compared with December 1995 and down 17.7 percent from a month earlier.
Tax revenue was slightly higher than the average forecast by analysts in a Reuters poll, who predicted collection of $3.77 billion.
